repos.description: Converts an amount between Ethereum units (wei, gwei, ether) from the command line.
Validates Ethereum addresses: 0x prefix, length and hex characters.
Calculates CO₂e from travel, home energy, diet and consumer goods using IPCC emission factors, and saves a JSON report.
